estimates.base_rate_detail: upgrades leg: trailing-12m rate 9/yr -> Poisson 90d P(>=3) 0.38 vs 2024+ empirical 0.13 and print-window 0.07, taken at 0.25; target leg: 63-session P(end >= +3.7%) 0.35 (all) x any-day 1.15 = 0.40; union ~0.45
estimates.conventions: upgrade = feed row Action==up with ToGrade Buy-equivalent, 17 Sep-15 Dec; initiations, reiterations and upgrades to Hold do not count; mean target = D convention (latest action per firm within 365 days), base $183.22 with Morgan Stanley $170; 'rise to >= $190' read as any feed date in the window

model.structure: S02 branches (0.24/0.14/0.10/0.52) -> S04 tape block replicated (known lags +0.65%, 0.305 p1, 0.205 p2pre, 0.40 x day-1, 0.14 x post, +0.5% stale, N(0,3.5%)) -> T_dec; any-day leg = paths above the quantile that makes P = 1.15 x P(T_dec >= 190); upgrades = NB(pre 0.7) + NB(post by branch 2.0/1.0/0.7/0.35, log-mean +0.06 per point of day-1 surprise), overdispersion 1.6
